# Vidimus — anchoring layer for business records (vidimus.be)

> Vidimus is a Belgian B2B service of VO Initiatives BV (Antwerp, company number BE 0805.309.143 in the KBO, the Belgian company register; founded 2023, founder Oskar Verschoren). Vidimus records business records (deliveries and CMRs, damage photos, inspections, contracts and documents, web pages, sensor measurements, snapshots of databases and folders) and anchors them: each record gets a fingerprint (SHA-256; for personal data with a secret salt per record) and a signature (Ed25519; key on the device of the person who signs, or a system key for connected systems). Within five minutes, records go per group into a Merkle tree with an external timestamp (RFC 3161), into a hash-chained ledger and, via OpenTimestamps, into Bitcoin. Groups with records from customer organisations receive a qualified timestamp from GLOBALTRUST (eIDAS) within six hours; the qualified timestamp is on the group, not on each record separately. Each record has an evidence bundle (.zip with content, manifest, certificates, timestamp files (.tsr), Bitcoin proof, Evidence Record according to RFC 4998 and verify_bundle.py) that a third party recomputes for themselves, also with DSS, the European Commission's software. Between businesses, evidence is weighed freely (Art. 8.11 of the Belgian Civil Code); whether a record holds up in a dispute is for the court to decide. Not legal advice.

## Key facts (short, for quoting)
- Name: Vidimus by VO Initiatives BV, Belgium (vidimus.be, app.vidimus.be). Not affiliated with the Python package "vidimus" on PyPI, with vidimus.org (a journal about stained glass) or with vidimus.io.
- What: one product for every kind of record; a record in the app (photo, location, signature of both parties) or automatically from software (TMS, WMS, ERP), sensors or databases via API or MCP.
- Outcome of a check: "unchanged" or "changed"; per check "matches" or "differs". Vidimus does not say what changed, not by whom, and not who is right.
- A logbook is a series of records of one kind (for example "Leveringen Halle", deliveries at Halle). What another system keeps itself is called that system's history; it sits in the same system as the data.
- Counterparties (customer, insurer, expert, court) check for themselves, without an account; with the evidence bundle even entirely without Vidimus.
- Price: first 100 records a month free; then €0.08 per record, cheaper per tier down to €0.003; sensor or logger €15 a month (first one free, unlimited measurements); minimum €19 a month once you pay anything; excl. VAT.
- Start: real records start once a director has identified their company with the Belgian eID (eID mandate, once); after that, a first logbook in a few minutes. The app and sign-up are in Dutch.
- Data: servers and storage in the EU (Hetzner, Germany), encrypted per organisation; in a confidential logbook only the customer holds the key and Vidimus sees the fingerprint and a short envelope (type, reference, source, time).
- Not: Vidimus is not an e-CMR platform and not a notary; it works alongside your e-CMR, TMS or ERP.

## For AI agents (how to use Vidimus)
- Public facts (no key needed): GET https://app.vidimus.be/verify/{registration_id} · GET https://app.vidimus.be/passport/{ref} · POST https://app.vidimus.be/verify-upload (bundle .zip as body)
- Key: always in the header `x-api-key: <key of your system or agent>`, never in the URL, and never the organisation key. Each key belongs to one system, device or AI assistant and can be revoked at any time. Never ask a user for a key in the chat and never show it.
- Read key (look up and check): GET /registrations?ref=… · GET /registrations/{id}/dossier · GET /registrations/{id}/content · GET /bundle/{id} · GET /sources/{id}/reeks (the series of a measurement source) · POST /lookup {sha256} · POST /registrations/{id}/tamper-check · GET /usage · POST /assist {question}
- Key of a system or device (records as that one source): POST /registrations (event, counted per record) · POST /measurements (measurement from a measurement source: {source_id, ts, values}, unlimited per measurement source) · POST /measurements/batch (buffer after an offline period) · GET /sources (the source itself, with its connection status) · POST /registrations/{id}/share · POST /ingest (old, counted per record)
- Connecting a system or device: the administrator creates it in the app, under Connect (an agent does not create sources or keys) → you receive a test key vks_test_… (records nothing; every response contains "proef": true) → test until the response contains "aanvaard": true (you can also use ?proef=true yourself) → have the system's own code send one message with the test key → after that successful test, the administrator creates the live key. It belongs in the system as the environment variable VIDIMUS_API_KEY, never in the chat, in code or in an MCP connection. Address and message stay the same; only the key changes.
- OpenAPI: https://app.vidimus.be/openapi.json (Swagger: https://app.vidimus.be/docs)
- MCP server, hosted (nothing to install): url https://app.vidimus.be/mcp (Streamable HTTP) with header `x-api-key: <key of your system or agent>` (or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`); when connecting, the test key (server name vidimus-test, VIDIMUS_TEST_KEY), for the AI assistant its own key (server name vidimus, VIDIMUS_MCP_KEY). Without a key, only the public tools. Works in Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and Codex; Claude in the browser, the Claude app and ChatGPT ask for a sign-in instead of a key and will follow later. There is no Vidimus package on PyPI from us (`pip install vidimus` belongs to someone else). Tools: verify_registration, passport, list_registrations, list_streams, get_dossier, get_content, register, connection_status, test_measurement, test_registration, create_share, tamper_check, usage, explain
- Verify independently without Vidimus: `python3 verify_bundle.py bundel.zip` (requires Python 3 + 'cryptography')
- Explanation for agents and people: https://vidimus.be/for-ai-agents.html

## Pages
- [Home](https://vidimus.be/): the anchoring layer for your data as a hub: four product lines and For software, how the proof works (SHA-256, Ed25519, RFC 3161 within five minutes, per group a qualified timestamp from GLOBALTRUST for customer organisations, Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps), a real check page and the forgery demo, European check (EU DSS), security and hosting (AES-256-GCM, Object Lock, Nuremberg), examples, pricing with price calculator, questions, the founder
- Products (one proof, four product lines):
  - [Vidimus App](https://vidimus.be/app.html): records on the spot in the app (photos, location, signature of both parties on their own phone), such as deliveries and CMRs, damage, handovers and inspections; the first 100 records a month free
  - [Vidimus Sensor](https://vidimus.be/sensor.html): sensors, loggers, meters and weighbridges send measurements via the API (POST /measurements); each measurement recorded and anchored separately; €15 per device per month with at least one measurement, the first one free, unlimited measurements
  - [Vidimus Data](https://vidimus.be/data.html): snapshots of databases and folders (fingerprints computed at the customer, content stays with the customer), web pages as proof; automatic every night and comparing a database after an incident are in development
  - [Vidimus Product Passport](https://vidimus.be/product-passport.html): records the line of an object (code with QR label, events, handovers signed by holder and recipient); Vidimus does not issue an official EU battery passport or digital product passport
  - [Vidimus Private](https://vidimus.be/private.html): on request; a dedicated environment for one organisation: its own keys, its own address, timestamps and anchors from outside
  - [Vidimus for software](https://vidimus.be/partners.html): partner API for makers of TMS, WMS and ERP
- [How it works](https://vidimus.be/how-it-works.html): seven steps from record to proof, with questions (cloud, Bitcoin, GDPR, discontinuation, integration, web pages, court)
- [Pricing](https://vidimus.be/pricing.html): price calculator, tier table, three sample invoices, annual contract (12 months for the price of 10), questions about the invoice
- [Technology](https://vidimus.be/technology.html): one record from start to proof, checking it yourself with DSS, what Vidimus proves and what it does not
- [Verify it yourself](https://vidimus.be/verify-it-yourself.html): checking an evidence bundle without Vidimus, step by step, for experts and auditors
- [Legal](https://vidimus.be/legal.html): the chain of evidence for an auditor, lawyer or court: what it proves and what it does not
- [Security](https://vidimus.be/security.html): EU hosting, encryption, keys, MFA, backups, incidents, what we do not have yet
- [Questions](https://vidimus.be/questions.html): the hardest questions (court, eIDAS, GDPR, discontinuation, storage, SLA, liability)
- [Partners](https://vidimus.be/partners.html): for software vendors (TMS, WMS, ERP, IoT): referral, reseller, integrator
- Use cases (one product, each time a different dispute):
  - [Transport and logistics: disputed delivery (CMR Art. 30)](https://vidimus.be/disputed-delivery-cmr.html)
  - [Real estate and rentals: disputed inspection report](https://vidimus.be/disputed-inspection-report.html)
  - [Construction and renovation: proving extra work](https://vidimus.be/proving-extra-work.html)
  - [Equipment rental: the handover report](https://vidimus.be/equipment-handover-damage.html)
  - [Recording a web page as proof: HTML, headers and screenshot, fetched by our server](https://vidimus.be/record-a-web-page.html)
  - [Cold chain and other fictional scenarios without and with anchoring (not customer stories)](https://vidimus.be/cases.html) · [Scenarios](https://vidimus.be/scenarios.html)
- [Vidimus, ProofSnap and TrueScreen: factual comparison with sources (27 October 2026)](https://vidimus.be/comparison-proofsnap-truescreen.html)

## Questions and answers (short answer at the top, then the chain of evidence and what it does not prove)
- [How do you prove that a photo was not edited?](https://vidimus.be/photo-proof-not-edited.html): fingerprint (SHA-256), device signature and external timestamp at the moment itself; does not prove that the scene was real and does not recognise AI images
- [How do you show after a hack that your database was not changed?](https://vidimus.be/database-proof-after-hack.html): only with an anchored snapshot from before the incident (fingerprint per row or file, computed at the customer); comparing per file today, per row in development
- [What does a qualified timestamp (eIDAS) prove?](https://vidimus.be/qualified-timestamp-eidas.html): legal presumption of accurate date and time and unchanged data (Art. 41(2)); at Vidimus from GLOBALTRUST, per group, only for groups with records from customer organisations; not who made the document
- [Refrigeration system hacked: what can you still show afterwards?](https://vidimus.be/refrigeration-system-hacked.html): after the cyberattack on refrigeration systems in November 2026; what the FASFC (the Belgian food safety agency) asks, what you should secure better, and what measurements from a separate logger do and do not show; Vidimus does not stop an attack
- [Temperature logger as proof for insurer and GDP audit](https://vidimus.be/temperature-logger-proof.html): each measurement anchored separately within five minutes; does not replace calibration; €15 per device per month, the first one free
- [Does WORM storage prove that nothing was changed?](https://vidimus.be/worm-storage-proof.html): Object Lock stops overwriting and deleting but cannot be recomputed by a third party; anchoring can; Vidimus does both (Object Lock in compliance mode, Hetzner Nuremberg)
